48.Name: TerritoryStone
48.Title: Territory Stone
48.value:
Place a Territory Stone to protect the surrounding area. Each player can own one territory. Players without permission cannot dig or place blocks inside it; the owner and administrators can. The owner may also allow teammates to enter and build.

When 'Block entry by non-members' is enabled, the boundary stops unauthorized players walking in from outside. Players already inside can still walk out, so a spawn or respawn cannot trap them. Turning this setting off allows passage, but does not grant digging or building rights. 'Show boundary' only changes visibility, not access. Animals are not blocked by the boundary.

The privileged tp command moves a player directly and bypasses the walking boundary, so it can enter a territory. Command permissions determine who may use tp. Aim at the stone and press G or the edit button to change settings; only the owner can change that territory's settings.

TerritorySettings.Title: Territory settings
TerritorySettings.ApplyToTeam: Allow teammates to enter and build

TerritoryProtection.EntryRestricted: You cannot enter this territory. You may leave, or ask the owner to allow entry.
TerritoryProtection.Protected: You cannot dig or place blocks in this territory.
TerritoryProtection.StoneOwnerOnly: Only the owner or an administrator can dig this Territory Stone.
TerritoryProtection.ClaimUnavailable: You already own a territory, or this area overlaps another territory.
